snippet.title: Project: A.W.O.L. - Devlog #1
snippet.description:
What makes Project: A.W.O.L. so special? Today we're talking about the advanced AI and pathfinding introduced to the BUILD engine that will make the enemy and friendly AI in Project: A.W.O.L. something never before seen!
